_help: EDIT THE NUMBERS AND SENTENCES HERE, then run:  pitch\build.bat   (or: python pitch\build.py)
Every figure and every claim in the video comes from this file: counters, captions, the lists of built / reused / limits, and the words the voice speaks.
The video is organised around the judging criteria (Problem 20 | Feasibility 15 | Technical 15 | User value 20 | Innovation 10 | Demo 10 | Brief 10).
A 'rail' at the bottom lights the criterion that is being shown, with one line of evidence, so a judge can find each of them.
Numbers below were read from the app on 14 Nov (Storage page, 4 recordings, 3.4 h) and from the test run (160 tests). Replace them with your final ones.
Honesty rules the judges check: say what was built and what was reused; say what is NOT proven. Do not turn an estimate into a result.
